title: dolicholus cunninghamii
intro: Dolicholus cunninghamii, commonly known as the "Squaw Weed" or "Dolicholus squawweed", is a perennial herb native to Australia and New Zealand. It has been traditionally used to treat menstrual and menopausal symptoms, offering health benefits such as reducing menstrual cramp intensity and alleviating symptoms of premenstrual syndrome (PMS). The therapeutic actions of Dolicholus cunninghamii include its ability to act as a uterine stimulant, a relaxant, and an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
